comment: Pinned eCapture releases — official GitHub releases only. sha256 values are taken from the release's own checksum-<version>.txt. aarch64 needs kernel >= 5.5 AND BTF (CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF / /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux); without BTF the CO-RE eBPF programs cannot load (see tools/ecapture_capture.sh --preflight-only).
